subject: Meeting notes from today
body: Hi team, attached are the notes from today's meeting. Please review them before Friday and let me know if I missed anything.

subject: Your leave request has been approved
body: Hello Priya, your leave from 20 Nov to 22 Nov has been approved by your manager. Enjoy your break.

subject: Transaction alert
body: Rs. 2,500 was debited from your account ending 1234 at BigBazaar on 09-Nov. If this was not you, please call the number printed on the back of your card.

subject: Dinner on Saturday?
body: Hey, are you free for dinner on Saturday? Thinking of trying the new place near the station. Let me know!

subject: Assignment 3 reminder
body: Dear students, a reminder that Assignment 3 is due next Monday. Submit it through the college portal. Office hours are Thursday 3-5 PM.

subject: Congratulations! You won $1,000,000
body: You are our lucky lottery winner! Claim reward now by replying with your full name and address to receive your million dollar prize.

subject: Work from home - earn Rs. 50,000 per day
body: No experience needed! Earn Rs. 50,000 daily from your phone. Limited seats. Pay a small registration fee of Rs. 999 to start immediately.

subject: Confidential business proposal
body: Dear friend, I am a prince with 25 million dollars to transfer out of my country. I need your help and will give you 30 percent. Reply urgently.

subject: Buy cheap pills and replica watches
body: Best prices guaranteed! Buy cheap pills and luxury replica watches with no prescription needed. Order now, free gift with every purchase.

subject: Double your money in 24 hours
body: Send us any amount of crypto and we will double it within 24 hours. Guaranteed returns, no risk, act now before the offer ends!

subject: Weekend Sale: Up to 50% off electronics
body: Check out our biggest weekend deals on headphones, laptops and more. Free shipping on orders above Rs. 499. Unsubscribe anytime using the link at the bottom of this email.

subject: Get 40% off your next order
body: Hungry? Use coupon code SAVE40 to get 40% off on your next order. Valid till Sunday. To stop receiving these emails, unsubscribe here.

subject: Your weekly reading digest
body: Here are this week's top stories picked for you: 5 habits of productive developers, a beginner's guide to Python, and more. Manage your email preferences or unsubscribe at any time.

subject: New arrivals just for you
body: Our winter collection has arrived. Enjoy flat 30% off on jackets and sweaters this week only. Shop now on our website. Unsubscribe from marketing emails here.

subject: Learn Python - limited time discount
body: Start learning Python today and save 25% on your first course. Offer ends Friday. You are receiving this email because you subscribed to our newsletter. Unsubscribe anytime.

subject: Urgent: Verify Your Account
body: Your account will be suspended in 24 hours. Click here to verify credentials and confirm your password to restore access.

subject: KYC expired - account will be blocked
body: Dear customer, your KYC has expired. Update immediately by clicking the link and entering your card number, CVV and the OTP sent to your phone, otherwise your account will be blocked today.

subject: Password expired - action required
body: Your Microsoft 365 password expires today. Sign in now using the link below to keep your mailbox active. Failure to verify your login will result in permanent deletion.

subject: Problem with your order payment
body: We could not process your payment. Update your payment details and confirm your bank account information within 12 hours or your order will be cancelled and your account limited.

subject: Salary credit on hold - confirm your details
body: Your salary for this month is on hold. Log in to the payroll portal using your company email and password to confirm your bank details and release the payment urgently.
